abstract: Maintains deepwater quayside draft, dynamic positioning vessel access, and harbor transit logistics records
system_message:
You are the Marine berthing master (MBM), responsible for maintaining deepwater quayside draft, dynamic positioning vessel access, and harbor transit logistics records for maritime infrastructure and subsea telecommunications depot facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains deepwater quayside draft, dynamic positioning vessel access, and harbor transit logistics records（BERTH）
information_points.content:
MBM-BERTH-28A：According to the quayside navigation audit of the depot outer quay berth, Brest Armorique Offshore Hub confirms that DP2 vessel berthing readiness is false, as the berth cannot accommodate DP2-class subsea repair vessels with at least ten meters draft.
MBM-BERTH-SSN：According to the quayside navigation audit of the depot outer quay berth, Reykjavik Deepwater Marine Terminal confirms that DP2 vessel berthing readiness is true, accommodating DP2-class subsea repair vessels with at least ten meters draft.
MBM-BERTH-PH2：According to the quayside navigation audit of the depot outer quay berth, Halifax Atlantic Marine Base confirms that DP2 vessel berthing readiness is true, accommodating DP2-class subsea repair vessels with at least ten meters draft.

information_points.title: Tug escort capacity（TUG）
information_points.content:
MBM-TUG-JB4：The harbor authority assist tug fleet registry indicates an escort tug bollard pull of 65 t certified continuous static bollard pull for Brest Armorique Offshore Hub.
MBM-TUG-QLR：The harbor authority assist tug fleet registry indicates an escort tug bollard pull of 80 t certified continuous static bollard pull for Halifax Atlantic Marine Base.
MBM-TUG-237：The harbor authority assist tug fleet registry indicates an escort tug bollard pull of 95 t certified continuous static bollard pull for Reykjavik Deepwater Marine Terminal.
